simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU C3503/C3507 family (chips/c3503.py, matched by "c3507_phy_set", chip ID 0x3507 at 0xB8000000 and 0xB8080000 -> SDK chip code 0x10056, run_dump_gtmedia_v9_prime_v207_app_starts.py, run_dump_gtmedia_v9_prime_v207_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader ("M3507---3") starts at 0xAFC00000 with CacheAsRam at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF, polls PLL ready bit 7 of 0xB8080253, copies itself to 0x82800000, and unpacks the 15.69 MB maincode ("V1.10B1*") to 0x80100200 (CP0 EBase 0x80102000).  Uses the C3507's 128-line interrupt controller at 0xB8081080 (status) / 0xB8081040 (enable) with VPO/DEO on line 68, video engine on line 72, GE_M36F on line 76, IR receiver on line 12, and interrupt-driven SCB1 I2C (0xB8018700, line 21) for its CH455 front panel.  With OTP word 0x210 bits 20..24 = 5 and the internal S3501H demodulator's chip ID 0x350100C0 at 0xB804C140, the application decodes its boot logo and renders its 1280x720 32-bpp ARGB8888 "Factory Test Page" OSD (Model: GTMedia V9 Prime[P], SW Ver: V203.03.06.28.207, 70 colours, 157 GE commands) on GMA layer 0.

desc: GTMedia V9 Prime official firmware V207 (2025-03-20) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the Full HD H.265/HEVC 10-bit DVB-S2X satellite receiver on the single-CPU ALi M3507 / C3507 SoC with 64 MB DDR2.

First ALi M3507 / C3507 (SDK chip code 0x10056) image in the catalog: combines an XIP CacheAsRam bootloader ("M3507---3", relocated to 0x82800000) with a 15.69 MB single-CPU application at 0x80100200, a 4-word (128-line) interrupt controller at 0xB8081080 / 0xB8081040, interrupt-driven SCB1 I2C for the CH455 panel, and the NIM_S3501H_0 internal DVB-S2X demodulator at 0xB804C000 (reading its 0x350100C0 chip ID from +0x140).
